headline: Sensex tumbles after early gains as market turns volatile; IT stocks surge while financials drag

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Markets reversed early gains due to profit-taking in financial and metal shares following a four-week rally.
Weak global cues and heavy selling pressure caused the Sensex to slide significantly from opening highs.
India VIX jumped nearly 8%, reflecting rising market volatility.
Global anti-AI trading dynamics provided tailwinds for Indian IT stocks.
whatHappening: The Sensex dropped over 800 points from early highs, dragging the Nifty below 25,600.
IT stocks outperformed the general market, with TCS and Tech Mahindra rising up to 5%.
Larsen & Toubro secured a large ₹5,000 crore order for an AI cluster project in Chennai.
Persistent Systems reported a data breach involving stolen employee data from a US law firm cyberattack.
summary: Indian benchmark indices opened higher but quickly succumbed to profit-taking in metal and banking stocks, driving the Sensex down over 800 points. Nifty fell below 25,600 as volatility surged amid weak global market cues. Despite market weakness, IT stocks such as TCS and Tech Mahindra rallied up to 5%, while L&T won a ₹5,000 crore AI order.
